# GalaxyXR-Forge (Copilot instructions)

Community index for Samsung Galaxy XR (SM-I610, Android XR) projects.

- `catalog.json` is the source of truth; `README.md` and `docs/index.html` are generated by `python tools/build.py` — never hand-edit them.
- After catalog edits run `python tools/build.py`, then `python tools/check-links.py` (all URLs must answer).
- Commit and push every completed change after the checks pass; stage only the files you changed and leave unrelated edits alone. If the push is rejected, open a PR.
- Keep group `id` values stable; one short factual line per repo (≤160 chars, target ~14 words).
- Full rules: [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).
